firstCutoverCounterPolicy: One-time first-release volatile counter reset is explicit. No old/new overlap is permitted; old memory cannot be imported. After cutover, all candidate replicas and restarts share persisted state. Zero-reset legacy continuity would require a separately enforced 60-second auth quiet period and is not claimed by this release.

deploymentPhases.name: PRE_MERGE_SAFE_CONFIG
deploymentPhases.allowedChanges: compatible non-forwarding variables and healthchecks only
deploymentPhases.gate: verify effective none; old services terminal SUCCESS; read-only checks

deploymentPhases.name: NEW_CODE_FIRST_DEPLOY
deploymentPhases.gate: both new deployments terminal SUCCESS, exact SHA; store and NONE startup markers; read-only checks; no old replicas serving

deploymentPhases.name: POST_CODE_FRAMEWORK_SWITCH
deploymentPhases.gate: backend-only config update after new code verified; FRAMEWORK startup marker and store readiness; read-only security rechecks

preconditions: New backend is live and verified with none
Old backend replicas have stopped serving

rollbackSequence: If new code fails while none: leave framework disabled; select previously healthy old deployment only with effective none.
If framework switch fails: restore none while new code remains active; verify healthy new version.
Before ever starting old code after framework phase: change effective forwarding back to none and verify it BEFORE old image activation.
Never run old code with framework or native; do not delete auxiliary table or restore database/rotate credentials.
securityInvariant: Old limiter must NEVER serve while effective forwarding strategy is framework; framework only after new code is live and verified, and reverted to none before any old-code rollback.
